top_signals.title: Oil Prices Rebound as Middle East Supply Fears Return
top_signals.summary: Crude oil prices, which fell to their lowest in four weeks, staged a rebound earlier today, as traders shifted their attention from the U.S. midterms to the Middle East, awaiting the next step in the war. Benchmarks dropped sharply on Tuesday on reports that Iran may be open to discussions on previously non-negotiable issues, but at the time of writing, Brent crude was trading at $103.60 per barrel, with West Texas Intermediate at $95.98 per barrel, after two energy consultancies warned against too much Gulf oil supply rebound optimism. top_signals.title: Mortgage rates drop for the third straight week, but homebuyers are still leaving the market
top_signals.summary: Mortgage rates came down again last week, but mortgage demand from homebuyers continued to decline, as high home prices and inflation stretch affordability.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Wayfair sales jump 10% as furniture retailer says it's winning share of sluggish market
top_signals.summary: Wayfair said its sales jumped 10% in the third quarter as the retailer posted its strongest quarter since the pandemic.
